item.tib: dzA this drag po'i bka' srung ma cig dbang gi lha mo'i mchod bskul
item.coloph: de ltar dz+wa sngags srung ma gnyen po la/ bskang bskul 'phrin las bcol ba'i las rim 'di/ bstan 'gro'i don du rig 'dzin bdag gis sbyar/ rjes 'jug gshen gyi nyams len gces par bzung (zungs) / dus mtha' bon bstan sa 'og gter gshegs dus/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug byang nub mtshams/ rin chen brag la gter sbos smon lam thob/ sa ma ya// phyis su phug leb 'o ma stag rtse nas/ zab mo gter gyi dngos grub rnyed de/ lo mong (mang) gsang rgya sdom (bsdams)/ slar hor blon bra bo nor bu rgya mtsho dang / rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bka' gter rigs phyir 'gyangs med par phab dgos kyi zhu ba rten 'brel lha rdzas kyi (kyis) mtshams sbyar bas/ shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab kyang / rkyen ngan dbang gis shog dril bar mtshams su chu (chud) zos shol (shor) ba'i 'phrin bcol skabs/ rtsom tshig phran bu sbyar dgos byung ba'i/ nyes 'gal ci mchis skyabs yul lha la bshags/ dge tshogs bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal gyur shog/
